cards.text: Jesus is going up to Jerusalem, and He takes the twelve disciples aside. He tells them they're headed to Jerusalem, and then He tells them what's going to happen there to the Son of Man. That's Jesus talking about Himself, friend, and when somebody pulls you aside in the middle of a road trip, it is NOT to talk about the playlist.

cards.question: Jesus says that in Jerusalem the Son of Man will be delivered over. Who will He be handed to?

answers.text: The merchants of Tyre and Sidon

cards.question: Jesus says the chief priests and scribes will condemn the Son of Man to death.
After condemning Him, the chief priests and scribes will deliver the Son of Man over to the ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus says He'll be mocked, flogged and crucified. Heavy words for the Twelve to carry up that road.

cards.question: But Jesus doesn't stop at the cross. What does He say happens on the third day?

answers.text: He will be raised to life
He will go back to Galilee
He will hide in the wilderness

cards.text: Then the mother of Zebedee's sons comes to Jesus with her sons, James and John, two of the Twelve (Matthew 4:21; 10:2). She kneels down to make a request, and friend, when somebody kneels BEFORE they even say what they want, that is NOT a small request.
Jesus asks her, “What do you want?” No small talk. Straight to it.

cards.question: What does the mother of Zebedee's sons ask Jesus to declare for her two sons in His kingdom?

answers.text: One sits at His right and one at His left
Both of them lead the other ten disciples
Both of them stand guard at His palace gate

cards.text: Jesus replies, “You do not know what you are asking,” and then He asks, “Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?” They came in asking about seats, and now we're talking about a cup.

cards.question: When Jesus asks if they can drink the cup He's going to drink, what do the two brothers answer?
Jesus tells the two brothers they will never drink His cup.
Jesus says sitting at His right or left isn't His to grant. Those seats belong to those for whom His ___ has prepared them.

cards.text: Then word gets around, because word ALWAYS gets around. The other ten disciples hear about this.

cards.question: When the other ten disciples hear what was asked, they are ___ with the two brothers.

cards.text: Two brothers asked for the best seats and got the HOT seat, and friend, you could cut that tension with a cookie cutter. Then Jesus calls them aside and talks about the rulers of the Gentiles.

cards.question: Jesus tells His disciples that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over their people.
Jesus says it shall not be that way among His disciples. Instead, whoever wants to become great among them must be their ___.

cards.text: And whoever wants to be first among them must be their slave. By THAT math, the greatest baker in my kitchen is whoever's elbow deep in the dirty mixing bowls, and then Jesus points to the Son of Man.

cards.question: Jesus says the Son of Man did not come to be served. What did He come to do?

answers.text: Serve and give His life as a ransom for many
Teach the rulers how to lead the Gentiles
Win the praise of the chief priests and scribes
